item.title: The great UK cloud reset: why cloud-first thinking is giving way to cloud-smart strategy
item.description: For nearly a decade, a cloud-first approach was the default position for most technology leaders in the UK. Boards would green-light public cloud migrations with the promise of agility, rapid deployment and avoiding large capital outlay. Technology teams would deliver, and the business would accelerate.
